YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r5.anchor: عن أبي مجلز قال: {لا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان} [النور: 21] قال: النذور في المعاصي

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r6.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r6.speaker: النبي
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r6.claim: The Prophet says there is no valid vow made in anger and its expiation is the expiation for an oath.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r6.anchor: عن عمران بن حصين قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لا نذر في غضب وكفارته كفارة اليمين»

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r7.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r7.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r7.claim: The statement about God's grace and mercy repeats the explanation just given for the earlier occurrence.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r8.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r8.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r8.claim: The phrase means that none of you would have become righteous.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r9.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r9.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r9.claim: God purifies means that God makes people righteous.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p434#2/r9.anchor: من أحد أبدا ولكن الله يزكي

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r1.claim: Worldly life is a test, and the ego and Satan are two major obstacles; religious guidance, knowledge, and education are divine help against them.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r1.anchor: Dünyada kul imtihandadır. İmtihanda başarının önemli iki engeli nefis ve şeytandır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r2.claim: Those who deprive themselves of this help by ignoring faith and guidance and misusing reason are unlikely to end worldly life with a clean record.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r2.anchor: kendilerini bu yardımdan mahrum bırakanların temiz bir amel defteriyle dünya hayatını noktalamaları imkânsız gibidir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r3.claim: God’s great grace is keeping repentance open throughout life, forgiving those who repent, and giving them a clean record.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:24:21/r3.anchor: tövbe kapısını açık tutması, tövbe edenleri bağışlaması, tövbekârlara temiz ve beyaz bir defter açmasıdır

ITQAN:v2p510#2/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r1.claim: As an exception-preventing particle, lawlā enters a nominal clause; a positive answer takes lām, a negative answer does not, and a following pronoun should be nominative.
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r1.anchor: أن تكون حرف امتناع لوجود فتدخل على الجملة الإسمية ويكون جوابها فعلا مقرونا باللام إن كان مثبتا

ITQAN:v2p510#2/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r2.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r2.claim: Lawlā can mean halā as exhortation or offer with a present verb, or express rebuke and regret in other contexts.

ITQAN:v2p510#2/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r3.speaker: الهروي
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r3.claim: Al-Harawī lists an interrogative use of lawlā, but the author says the cited examples more likely mean halā.
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r3.anchor: الثالث أن تكون للاستفهام ذكر الهروي وجعل منه

ITQAN:v2p510#2/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r4.speaker: الجمهور
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r4.claim: Al-Harawī treats lawlā in فلولا كانت قرية آمنت as negation, but the majority reject that analysis and read the verse as rebuking failure to believe before punishment, supported by Ubayy's هلا reading.
ITQAN:v2p510#2/r4.anchor: والجمهور لم يثبتوا ذلك وقالوا المراد في الآية التوبيخ على ترك الإيمان قبل مجيء العذاب ويؤيده قراءة أبي فهلا

BURHAN:v4p375/r8.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p375/r8.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p375/r8.claim: When the response to لولا is negative, Qur'anic usage omits it; this contradicts Ibn Asfur's claim that a negative with ما is better accompanied by لام.
BURHAN:v4p375/r8.anchor: وأما جوابها إذا كان منفيا فجاء القرآن بالحذف
